thesis: The earnings pop has already been sold: the 31.00 high on 11/06 was rejected with a long upper wick and the stock sits above the mean analyst target, with only about 1.4R to the 52-week high. Price is roughly 6% above SMA20 after a gap, so the pullback entry is still extended and a fill back toward 26.3-26.9 is plausible. Margin quality is deteriorating (gross margin 48%, rising IMS remediation costs, pricing pressure) while short interest near 21.7% of float makes moves violent in both directions. The regime is neutral with weak tech and rising yields, and a small-cap in a risk-off drift has little tailwind.
